summary: Frontend-only verification of the new 12-section admin sidebar. All 12 top-level nav items exist with correct data-testids, route to the expected paths, and receive the green (bg-forest) active highlight on their route. Products sub-nav (Catalog/Categories/Subcategories/Brands) works and Inventory is a SEPARATE top-level item (not nested). Delivery/PIN Codes, Combos & Banners, Settings, Coupons & Discounts, and Customers all expand to correct sub-links. AdminReferrals page renders with summary cards, anti-self-referral banner ('Anti-self-referral: Enforced — self-referral blocked at apply time') and referrers table. Mobile viewport (390x844): desktop sidebar hidden, hamburger (admin-mobile-menu) opens a drawer containing the same 12 items, tapping an item navigates and auto-closes the drawer. Regression across 21 admin routes: all render with sidebar and no React uncaught runtime error boundary. Inventory page shows PIN selector + Enable All buttons.

minor.issue: Two 500 responses observed once when opening Analytics (visible in webpack dev overlay); not reproduced on subsequent visits. Out of scope for this frontend-only sidebar review but worth confirming.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminLayout.js is clean, uses data-testids consistently and derives active state from pathname + match[] prefixes — good.
Sub-nav testids are generated from label slugify; naming works but future label changes will silently break tests — consider explicit testids per child link.
Analytics page may hit a 500 endpoint (seen once); confirm /api/admin/expenses (or the analytics backend) is stable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 12-section sidebar is fully working. All nav-<slug> and subnav-<slug> testids confirmed. AdminReferrals loads and consumes GET /api/admin/referrals successfully. Mobile drawer via Sheet works and closes on navigation. If reviewing analytics, verify /api/admin/expenses stability (intermittent 500 seen once).
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in scope.
